description_en: A shallow rectangular woven messenger case with large leather flap and adjustable webbing strap. Canonical front: two leather closure tabs on the broad flap. Side view: an expandable textile gusset bordered by cane binding. Rear view: a full-width woven panel with a vertical belt loop. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A shallow rectangular woven messenger case with large leather flap and adjustable webbing strap. Canonical front: two leather closure tabs on the broad flap. Side view: an expandable textile gusset bordered by cane binding. Rear view: a full-width woven panel with a vertical belt loop. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
